say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: The wild herd is finally calming down and wandering back toward the hills. That Great Tusk was the only one of its kind... but it terrified all of them.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: The Royal Guard is opening the Emerald Capital gates for us now. Come, everyone. If a single Rift behemoth can stampede a whole mountainside, King Serperior must hear of this at once.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Time to hear the truth about why the King summoned us.
